label: Table 3.1
caption: Table 3.1 Guarding heights
description:
Table 3.1 is a two‑column table with a green band across the top containing the text "Table 3.1" and the heading "Guarding heights". The left‑hand column is headed "Change in floor level between inside and outside" and the right‑hand column is headed "Guarding height(1)", the (1) being a superscript that refers to note 1 below the table. There are two data rows. In the first row the left cell reads "Less than 600mm" and the right cell reads "See Approved Document K". In the second row the left cell reads "More than 600mm" and the right cell reads "1.1m". The grid contains no ticks, crosses, circles or coloured cells to decode; the only non‑text material inside the table is a line drawing in the lower part of the table, beneath the "1.1m" entry.

The drawing is a cross‑section showing a change of floor level, with the wall and floor sections filled in light grey. On the left is a taller grey section, drawn as a vertical block standing on a wider horizontal base; on the right is a lower grey section, drawn in an L shape, so that the left‑hand floor level is below the right‑hand one and there is a gap between the two sections at the step. From the top of the left grey block several thin vertical lines rise upwards, and from the top of the vertical part of the right grey section further thin vertical lines rise, representing the guarding on each side of the opening. In the middle, between these two sets of vertical lines, there is a small grey square, and a vertical green double‑headed dimension arrow labelled "Less than 100mm(2)" (the (2) being a superscript referring to note 2) runs from the bottom of that square down to the top of the right‑hand floor, with the label set to the left of the arrow. From the tops of the vertical lines, dashed diagonal lines run downwards to the right, each one ending in a thin curved (arc‑shaped) line. To the far right of the drawing, a vertical green double‑headed dimension arrow labelled "1.1m" spans the height from the top of the guarding down to the level of the lower floor.

Below the table, under the heading "NOTES:", there are two numbered notes. Note 1 reads: "This approved document has increased levels of protection from falling compared to Approved Document K. Where applicable, the higher standard applies." Note 2 reads: "Guarding should be sized to prevent the passage of a 100mm sphere."
